facts.fact: OBS-CC says Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 creates the Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) in article 53, but the presidential decree organising it and appointing members had not been published when it checked the presidency's list on 14 September 2026.
